title: Visual-Aware Representation of Web Pages for Machine Learning Applications
abstract: arXiv:2608.18727v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Applying machine learning to web pages is challenging due to the need to interpret HTML together with associated resources and perform rendering to obtain a meaningful visual and layout-aware representation. As a result, machine learning over web content remains comparatively underexplored. In this paper, we present a platform for visual-aware representation and machine learning over web pages based on the open-source rendering tool FitLayout. The platform provides a server capable of rendering web pages, explicitly capturing their visual and structural properties in an RDF-based representation, and persisting the rendered documents in an integrated storage. The processing pipeline is controlled via a REST API, while SPARQL queries are used to retrieve structured data suitable as input for machine learning algorithms. translated_title: 面向机器学习应用的网页视觉感知表示
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.18727v1 公告类型：新公告 摘要：将机器学习应用于网页具有挑战性，因为需要解释HTML及其相关资源，并执行渲染以获得有意义的视觉和布局感知表示。因此，基于网页内容的机器学习研究相对不足。在本文中，我们提出了一个基于开源渲染工具FitLayout的视觉感知表示和网页机器学习平台。该平台提供能够渲染网页的服务器，明确捕获其视觉和结构属性为基于RDF的表示，并将渲染后的文档持久化在集成存储中。处理流程通过REST API控制，而SPARQL查询用于检索适合作为机器学习算法输入的结构化数据。通过显式建模渲染后的网页（包括细粒度布局细节），该平台实现了数据集共享。
tldr: 该平台利用FitLayout渲染网页并生成RDF表示的视觉感知数据，通过REST API和SPARQL查询支持机器学习应用，实现细粒度布局数据的共享。
en_tdlr: This platform renders web pages using FitLayout and generates RDF-based visual-aware representations, supporting machine learning applications via REST API and SPARQL queries while enabling fine-grained layout data sharing.
